name: National ID
description: National identity document credential containing personal identification data.
summary: Credential type template for urn:idunion.org:nid_copy:1, a national identity document credential in sd_jwt_vc format against the Triveria national-id schema. Subject form groups: Personal Information (firstName, familyName, dateOfBirth, ageOver18, gender, nationality, photo) and Identity (idNumber, personalIdentifier, address). Issued by the NOOP Identity Authority wallet template and requested by the national_id_identity_disclosure verifiers of the EBSI, IDTL and NOOP wallet templates.
